function.name: respond_to_approval
function.description: Report the user's decision on a subagent's pending approval request. Classify the user's reply as 'yes' (approve), 'no' (reject), or 'other' (anything that is not a clear yes or no). For 'no' and 'other', put the user's words in 'note' so the subagent can reconsider.

agent.description: The id of the agent awaiting the decision (e.g. "agent-7"), taken from the approval request you were shown.

verdict.description: Your classification of the user's reply: yes = approve, no = reject, other = neither a clear yes nor no.

note.description: Optional reason or the user's own words; used as the rejection reason for 'no' and 'other'.
